items.title: Quest
items.desc: Escape rooms, VR, challenges, and adrenaline-filled activities for anyone who'd rather move, solve, and compete than sit still.

items.title: CUISINE
items.desc: Group dinners, halal restaurant crawls, food adventures, and the occasional cooking night for anyone who plans their week around food.

items.title: ARTS
items.desc: Painting nights, DIY sessions, creative workshops, and low-key crafternoons — no talent required, just a willingness to make something.

items.title: Field
items.desc: Lakes, hikes, cabins, nature days, and the occasional getaways for when the group chat needs to actually leave the city.
